label.purpose: Accessible name of the track table.
label.where: Library, All music and crate screens, the track table (screen readers only).

columns.title.purpose: Column heading for a track's title.

columns.artist.purpose: Column heading for a track's artist.

columns.bpm.purpose: Column heading for a track's tempo.

columns.key.purpose: Column heading for a track's musical key.

columns.time.purpose: Column heading for a track's length.

columns.genre.purpose: Column heading for a track's genre.

columns.rating.purpose: Column heading for a track's star rating.

columns.dateAdded.purpose: Column heading for when a track was added: to the Library, or in All music for a track not in the Library, when it was first found.

columns.file.purpose: Column heading for a track's file name.

columns.folder.purpose: Column heading for the folder a track's file is in.

columns.actions.purpose: Accessible name of the actions column (visually hidden).
columns.actions.where: Track table header, last column (screen readers only).

sortBy.purpose: Hover text and accessible name of a column heading that sorts the table.
sortBy.where: Track table header buttons ({{column}} is the column's name).

rating_one.purpose: A star rating, for screen readers and hover text, when it is one star.

rating_other.purpose: A star rating, for screen readers and hover text, when it is several stars.

updating.purpose: Says the table may be out of date for a moment, because the background work that sorts and filters it hasn't caught up with a change.
updating.where: Above the track table, only while that work is running.

noMatch.purpose: Says no track fits the search and the filters. Same wording as All music's (allMusic:noMatch).
noMatch.where: Track table, in place of the rows.

filters.label.purpose: Accessible name of the row of filters above the table.
filters.label.where: Above the track table (screen readers only).

filters.add.purpose: Button that opens the list of filters that can be added.
filters.add.where: Above the track table, after the filter chips.

filters.menu.purpose: Accessible name of the list of filters that can be added.
filters.menu.where: The menu opened by Add filter (screen readers only).

filters.formats.purpose: Heading over the file formats the table can be filtered to.
filters.formats.where: The menu opened by Add filter, over the formats.

filters.none.purpose: Says every filter on offer is already in use.
filters.none.where: The menu opened by Add filter, when nothing is left to add.

filters.remove.purpose: Accessible name of the × on a filter chip, naming the filter.
filters.remove.where: Above the track table, each filter chip's × ({{filter}} is the chip's text).

filters.missing.purpose: Filter: tracks whose file isn't on disk.
filters.missing.where: Filter chip and its menu entry.

filters.inRekordbox.purpose: Filter: tracks rekordbox has. rekordbox is written as rekordbox shows it.
filters.inRekordbox.where: Filter chip and its menu entry.

filters.notInRekordbox.where: Filter chip and its menu entry.

filters.format.purpose: Filter: tracks whose file is in one format.
filters.format.where: Filter chip ({{format}} is the format's name, e.g. FLAC).

filters.qualityProblem.purpose: Filter: the tracks Review lists under Quality problems (a Library track whose linked file is flagged with no better copy and no answer, or one with a better file available).
filters.qualityProblem.where: Filter chip and its menu entry.

filters.inCrate.purpose: Filter: tracks that are in at least one crate.
filters.inCrate.where: Filter chip and its menu entry, Library.

filters.inNoCrate.purpose: Filter: tracks that are in no crate.
filters.inNoCrate.where: Filter chip and its menu entry, Library.

filters.inLibrary.purpose: Filter: tracks in the Library. Same wording as allMusic:inLibrary.
filters.inLibrary.where: Filter chip and its menu entry, All music.

filters.notInLibrary.purpose: Filter: tracks not in the Library.
filters.notInLibrary.where: Filter chip and its menu entry, All music.

format.mp3.purpose: The name of a file format (a technical name, as the format is known), for a filter chip and the formats menu.
format.mp3.where: Filter chip and the Add filter menu, the formats.
